title: Quenched Peppery Mexican Mozzarella Quesadilla
description: A spicy, tangy quesadilla packed with fresh bell pepper, smoky binchotan charcoal flavor, and oozy mozzarella, served with a zesty lime cilantro drizzle.
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium heat and lightly coat with a teaspoon of olive oil.
Toast each tortilla for 30 seconds on each side until warm and pliable, then set aside.
In the skillet, add a dash of olive oil and sauté cumin seeds until fragrant, about 30 seconds.
Add sliced onion and bell pepper, cooking until softened and slightly caramelized, about 5 minutes.
Stir in smoked paprika, binchotan charcoal powder, and lime juice, cooking for an additional minute to bloom the spices.
Remove the pepper and onion mixture from the skillet and set aside.
Place one tortilla on the skillet, sprinkle half the mozzarella evenly across, top with the sautéed vegetables, then add the remaining cheese and a sprinkle of cilantro.
Cover with the second tortilla and cook for 2-3 minutes per side, pressing gently, until the cheese melts and the tortillas are golden brown.
Slice the quesadilla into wedges and serve hot, optionally with a side of lime wedges or a fresh salsa.
